Edit

Create exactly one standalone 9:16 vertical image in the established editorial ink-wash world: warm lightly toothy ivory paper, faint dry-brush pooling and restrained print wear, soft charcoal-ink contours with imperfect brush variation, subtle hatching, muted taupe and recession-gray browns, dusty sage/desaturated teal, restrained ochre, and selective lipstick-red accents. Visualize the proposed inverse relationship between a weakening economy and rising lipstick sales as a simple human-readable metaphor: across a wide graphic composition, a heavy recession-gray economic slope descends diagonally on one side while several physical lipstick tubes rise progressively upward on the other, creating strong opposing diagonal motion. Keep the relationship suggestive rather than scientifically certain; use no numbers, arrows, axes, labels, graphs with text, or predictive-certainty symbols. Maintain soft diffuse editorial daylight, gentle warm paper glow, subdued gray shadows, and the recurring inset illustration window formed by loose charcoal-and-ink boundary marks on the same worn editorial sheet. Fill the full illustration height naturally—no lower caption reserve, blank strip, empty panel, or deliberately low-detail subtitle band. The style_reference governs the ink-wash rendering language, palette, linework, and tactile print character; the world_keyframe establishes the recurring editorial page and inset-window frame language without supplying a composition to copy; the previous_beat is binding only for recurring material/edge treatment, texture, palette, lighting, and frame continuity, never its crop, camera angle, subject placement, focal object, or layout. No people. No photorealism, glossy 3D, anime, neon, polished corporate vector art, hyper-saturated advertising, storyboard, grid, collage, multiple panels, captions, UI, letters, numbers, labels, words, or any readable text. NON-NEGOTIABLE EPISODE FRAME CONTRACT: Preserve this recurring frame language in this image: a recurring warm ivory editorial page with lightly worn irregular paper edges, faint ink pooling, restrained print wear, and a consistent inset illustration window defined by loose charcoal-and-ink boundary marks; each body image should feel printed or washed onto the same tactile editorial sheet, with lipstick-red appearing only as a controlled recurring accent. Preserve its material/edge grammar, texture, palette and inner illustration window while changing only the scene inside it. Do not reserve a lower caption field, blank strip, empty panel or low-detail band. Continue the scene and its natural texture through the full usable height, guided by the previous accepted image, without adding text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, words or UI.
